$comment: Numbers for the visual-bug feature on genclass.dev (/ and /visual). How to fill it: README.md in this folder. status "live" shows the measured checks' numbers (the checks block must be complete); the learned model's numbers show only once model.status is "live", and the crawl figure only once crawl.status is "live". Every number in checks is copied from docs/runtime/RESULTS.md sections 8 and 9 at commit 6ae209f on branch wave2/visual (linked under sources).

fixtures.$source: RESULTS.md section 8, first row: visual.spec.ts, 24 tests passed
fixtures.on: fixture pages written by the same author as the checks

recall.$source: RESULTS.md section 9, Recall on planted faults (run 4; run 5 the same except pointer-events-leak, 17 of 18, 0.94)
recall.on: faults applied from the harness to the 7 demo pages, the 4 templates and the 7 compat apps (scenario h), at desktop and phone width, each checked to have taken before it counts
recall.misses: Every click-blocked and scroll-lock-stuck miss is on one of the six demo pages, which update their DOM all the time; both checks wait for a moment with no DOM change, so they stay silent on such pages. css-var-undefined missed one phone load. The pointer-events-leak miss is a compat app whose requests were in flight during the reads: since the review a lock is not judged while a request runs.

clean.$source: RESULTS.md section 9, Clean local pages (runs 4 and 5, the same)
clean.loads: Desktop 1280 x 800 and phone 390 x 844, light and dark, with scripted hover over 8 controls, 8 Tab presses and scrolling to the end
clean.real: The two findings are one real bug in two colour schemes: on the demos index at desktop width, the content under the hero headline moves 59 px 0.2 s after navigation start (a layout-shift window of 0.34). It is labelled real and the demo is left alone. The same zero false reports held in all five runs.

public.on: 40 home pages: documentation, news, government, SaaS, shops, code hosting, an encyclopedia, design sites. One load per site and configuration, no clicks, no forms; dark loads only where the site has a dark design. Each finding was looked at from its element crop.
public.real: The 5 confirmed real findings in run 4 are 3 bugs on 2 of the 40 sites, each found in two colour schemes where it applies: on a phone, a statistic 16 px wider than the 390 px viewport, so the page scrolls sideways; on a phone, a layout shift of 0.27 that moves the content below by 782 px; on a phone, a keyboard-focused link hidden under a fixed announcement banner. Bot challenges, HTTP errors and rate-limited loads are not measured.

cost.$source: RESULTS.md section 8 (lazy chunk, first-load growth after the review) and section 9, Cost (run 5) and Proposed gates on run 5
cost.note: Three of the proposed cost gates are not met yet: p95 pass time on public sites is 95.2 ms against at most 50 ms, the longest slice at p95 is 18.9 ms on public sites against at most 12 ms, and the first pass finishes inside 100 ms at 4x throttling on 78.1% of local pages against at least 90%.
